moments.title: Strictly Live Shows Begin
moments.blurb: After Saturday's launch, the first live competitive shows of Strictly Come Dancing 2026 kick off this weekend, with celebrity-professional pairings performing for judges and viewers.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Who are you backing to lift the Glitterball? The Strictly Come Dancing live shows begin this Saturday!

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: New hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are ready! Catch the first live dances on Strictly Come Dancing this weekend.

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 2026 series on Channel 4 this Tuesday at 8pm, featuring new judge Nigella Lawson.

angles.name: Excitement
angles.copy: Ready, set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off is back tomorrow night with a new judge in the tent. Who's excited?

angles.name: New Judge
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a new judge for Bake Off 2026! Don't miss the return tomorrow at 8pm on Channel 4.

moments.title: Premier League Midweek Fixtures
moments.blurb: The Premier League continues with a busy schedule of midweek fixtures from Tuesday, September 22nd to Thursday, September 24th.

angles.name: Match Talk
angles.copy: Midweek Premier League action is here! Which games are you watching, and who needs a win the most?

angles.name: Predictions
angles.copy: Time for some midweek football! Any shock results on the cards for the Premier League fixtures this week?

moments.title: Sienna Spiro Holds UK #1
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for a second consecutive week, making her the youngest British female to top the charts since 2014.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Two weeks at #1 for Sienna Spiro! 'Great Expectation' is still the biggest song in the UK. Have you streamed it today?

angles.name: Rising Star
angles.copy: Sienna Spiro continues her reign at #1 with 'Great Expectation'. A massive track from a rising British star!

moments.title: Autumn Equinox
moments.blurb: Astronomical autumn officially begins on Wednesday, September 23rd at 1:05 AM BST, marking the Autumn Equinox.

angles.name: First Day of Autumn
angles.copy: Wrap up warm! Astronomical autumn officially begins on Wednesday with the Autumn Equinox. What's your favourite thing about this season?

angles.name: Longer Nights
angles.copy: The Autumn Equinox arrives Wednesday, meaning nights will now be longer than days. Hello cosy evenings!

moments.title: Harvest Moon
moments.blurb: The full moon closest to the Autumn Equinox, known as the Harvest Moon, will appear on Saturday, September 26th.

angles.name: Moon Gazing
angles.copy: Look up this Saturday! The beautiful Harvest Moon will light up the night sky, perfect for some autumn stargazing.

angles.name: Autumnal Glow
angles.copy: The Harvest Moon is traditionally associated with farmers gathering crops. We'll be enjoying its autumnal glow this weekend!

moments.title: Super League Grand Final Build-up
moments.blurb: The Betfred Super League Grand Final will take place on Saturday, October 3rd at Old Trafford, with anticipation building for Rugby League's biggest night.

angles.name: Rugby Fever
angles.copy: Less than two weeks until the Betfred Super League Grand Final! Who are you rooting for at Old Trafford?

angles.name: Big Game
angles.copy: The biggest night in Rugby League is fast approaching! Get ready for the Super League Grand Final on October 3rd.

moments.title: TLC's 'No Scrubs' Re-enters Top 40
moments.blurb: The 1999 R&B classic 'No Scrubs' by TLC has re-entered the Official UK Top 40 singles chart for the first time in 27 years, following a viral social media trend.

angles.name: 90s Revival
angles.copy: Don't want no scrubs? Apparently, the UK charts do! TLC's 90s anthem 'No Scrubs' is back in the Top 40 thanks to a viral trend!

angles.name: Viral Comeback
angles.copy: TLC's 'No Scrubs' is having an unexpected comeback! The 1999 hit is re-entering the Top 40. Is it still a bop?

moments.title: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' in Top 40

angles.name: Welsh Talent

angles.name: Dance Trend
angles.copy: 'Babydoll' by Jamie Miller is soundtracking a massive new dance trend and is now in the Top 40! Get ready to move!

angles.name: Jazz Legend

angles.name: Musical Legacy
angles.copy: 100 years since his birth, John Coltrane's influence is still felt across music. Tune in Wednesday for a tribute to a true titan of jazz.
